proposal.reason: Main functional change is review-routing/gate automation behavior: PR-number normalization and handoff, invitation sync semantics, and non-fatal handling of HTTP 422 withdrawal failures. Evidence: .github/scripts/review_automation.py changes required_reviewers/invitation withdrawal flow; .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py adds identify mode and stricter PR-number parsing; .github/workflows/review-gate.yml and review-routing.yml rewire PR-number source and concurrency key. This outweighs other candidates because module-catalog/classification-boundary edits are governance of review automation (also workflow), not substantive runtime library changes in copy-engine/symmetric/ci.
